name: due-brand-deal-commercials
description: DUE checker for the commercial terms in a brand deal, UGC brief or collab offer you paste. No account needed; nothing is sent to anyone. General information, not legal advice.

interface.longDescription: For creators managing paid brand collaborations, review the business terms in a pasted brand or UGC brief before agreeing. Paste the terms and DUE Brand Deal Commercials shows the fee, deliverables, when you get paid, ad and usage rights, whitelisting, exclusivity, revisions, kill fee, expenses and deadlines, quoting the text, plus what is not stated and questions you could ask the brand. No DUE account needed. Read-only: it only checks the text you paste and never fetches links, contacts brands or sends anything. General commercial information, not legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Is this brand deal fair? Here are the terms:
Can the brand use my video in ads under these UGC terms?
When should I get paid under this collab offer?

positive.prompt: Is this brand deal fair? Glow Co would love 2 TikTok videos (30-45s) and 1 Instagram Reel for our serum launch. Fee is AUD 1,200. Drafts due 3 November 2026. We may use the content in paid ads in perpetuity. Payment net 60 from invoice. Exclusivity: no other skincare brands for 90 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Status high_risk; fee AUD 1,200; deliverables listed; a high flag quoting "in perpetuity"; flags for net 60 and exclusivity; questions to ask; a not-legal-advice limitation.

positive.prompt: What am I actually agreeing to? Glow Co would love 2 TikTok videos (30-45s) and 1 Instagram Reel for our serum launch. Fee is AUD 1,200. Drafts due 3 November 2026. positive.expected_behavior: Revisions, cancellation/kill fee and expenses listed as not stated, not invented.
